In mathematical [[invariant theory]], the '''canonizant''' or '''canonisant''' is a covariant of forms related to a canonical form for them.

==Canonizants of a binary form==

The canonizant of a binary form of degree 2''n''&nbsp;–&nbsp;1 is a covariant of degree ''n'' and order ''n'', given by the [[catalecticant]] of the penultimate emanant, which is the [[determinant]] of the ''n'' by ''n'' [[Hankel matrix]] with entries ''a''<sub>''i''+''j''</sub>''x''&nbsp;+&nbsp;''a''<sub>''i''+''j''+1</sub>''y'' for 0&nbsp;≤&nbsp;''i'',''j''&nbsp;<&nbsp;''n''.
